holy.label: The staff that only pointed at one
holy.explanation: A level fifty priest wears a ring carrying the staff-holiness activation and faces three white harpies to its east. The activation floods the area with goodness - every evil monster in sight - but the maneuver kept the bolt radius of zero and valued a single harpy on a line: twenty-eight. The correction uses the LOS-dispel radius of ten, which the corrected launch values as the sight-line sum: sixty.
